companyDescription: Psychedelic psychiatry · HLP003 (deuterated psilocybin analog, formerly CYB003) in Phase 3 for adjunctive MDD — APPROACH topline guided Q4 2026, EMBRACE second pivotal enrolling, NDA targeted 2028
priceNote: Live $8.85 (-2.0%) on Nov 4, 2026, down ~14% from $10.31 at the Oct 26 report. Shares fell ~18% in one session on rival Usona's FDA filing news. 52-week range $3.76-$15.15. Market cap ~$646M. Nov 4 tape: S&P futures -1.2% / Nasdaq -2% on a Democratic midterm sweep; Dec 9 hike ~85% priced.
summary: REFRESH (prior report Oct 26, 2026). The APPROACH Phase 3 topline for HLP003 in adjunctive MDD (223 patients, fully enrolled Jul 2026) is still guided to Q4 2026, as reiterated at the Oct 21 investor presentation, but no exact date has been given. The stock lost ~14% since Oct 26, mostly on the ~18% one-day drop on Usona's competing FDA filing. That lowers the entry, but it is also a reminder that the psychedelic race has more than one runner. Consensus is $41.40 (11 analysts), but the Compass precedent (Phase 3 hit, stock -36-47% on effect size) is the main risk to the pop. phase3_readout has n=1 in the feedback file, so it is context only. Base +55% ($13.70, near the September high) assumes a clean separation of ≥5 MADRS points within ~1-2 months of the readout, above the lane's realized 30-day P75 (+12.2%; Base bias +72.7pp). แนะนำ 2-3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้าผลออกมาอ่อน ลงได้ 40-60%.

catalysts.name: APPROACH Phase 3 topline — HLP003 adjunctive MDD
catalysts.description: Pivotal, 1:1 randomized (16 mg vs placebo, two doses three weeks apart), 223 participants. Topline including key secondaries guided to Q4 2026, reaffirmed Oct 21. The market bar is ≥5-point MADRS separation (the Compass lesson).

catalysts.name: Fiscal Q2 results
catalysts.description: Cash and runway check against the $100M ATM; any narrowing of the APPROACH topline window.

risks: Sell-the-news risk: Compass hit its Phase 3 primary endpoint in Jun 2025 and still fell 36-47% because the effect size missed the ~5-point MADRS bar. HELP needs a clear separation, not just statistical significance.
Competitive race: Usona's FDA filing news cost HELP ~18% in a day. A rival ahead in the regulatory queue compresses the first-mover premium.
Runway is ~12-14 months on ~$166M cash with a $100M ATM. That clears the survival bar but only just; expect a raise after positive data, and a punitive one after a miss.
Functional unblinding and expectancy effects are a known FDA concern for psychedelic trials, and the FDA rejected Lykos's MDMA application (Aug 2024).
The topline date is undisclosed ('Q4 2026'). A slip into 2027 adds time decay and financing risk.

estimateDates.note: Primary MADRS change + key secondaries; the market bar is ≥5-point separation

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28 (10–2 vote; Cook and Hammack dissented for a hike). Futures price ~85% odds of another +25bp at the Dec 9 FOMC after Logan and Musalem called for more tightening; Warsh gave no explicit December signal.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Sep PCE: headline 3.6% y/y (+0.5% m/m), core 3.1% y/y (+0.3% m/m); Q3 GDP +3.4% annualized. Oct CPI on Nov 10 is the next test — core ≥0.4% m/m would effectively lock in the December hike.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Pre-revenue psychiatry biotech funded by equity. The readout dominates; higher-for-longer rates raise the cost of the post-data raise and weigh on long-duration biotech multiples.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the readout window overlaps the Dec 9 FOMC (~85% hike priced). A risk-off December would mute a positive topline's first-day move.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE · Moonshot 2% max (refreshed Nov 4). A cheaper entry after the Usona-driven drop, but an undated Q4 readout, a ~12-14 month runway and the Compass sell-the-news template keep size small. Measured turbo at-catalyst median is -13.7% (n=19), so Entry 2 ($7.40-8.00) is preferred.

catalystSpot.preRunup: HELP ran +170%+ off its low into the September high ($15.15), then gave back ~40% on Usona's filing and the small-cap selloff, so the pre-readout froth has been flushed.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: Final 4-6 weeks before the Q4 readout

postWin.note: Psychedelic readouts have not produced 3x days: ATAI +30% on Beckley BPL-003 Phase 2b (Jul 2025), CYBN +8% on CYB003 Phase 2 interim (Nov 2023). The Moon case needs EMBRACE and an NDA path, not one readout.

postLose.note: Compass COMP005 (Jun 23, 2025) hit its primary endpoint but showed only a -3.6 MADRS separation versus a ~5-point bar; shares fell 36-47% intraday.

spotSizing.reason: 2%. phase3_readout has no n≥5 bucket (n=1, context only), so the weak lane prior (hitRate 4.9%, medianExcess +2.0pp) governs, and the sector's own history shows positive psychedelic readouts producing +8-30%, not 3x.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Wider than the overall turbo medianMAE (-24.1%). A break below ~$6.65 pre-readout means the race/financing story is winning over the data.

stopPostCatalyst.note: If the MADRS separation is < 3 points or the primary misses, exit day 1. The Compass precedent shows no recovery bounce.

comparableCases.event: COMP005 Phase 3 psilocybin (TRD) hits primary endpoint
comparableCases.note: The key template: a technically positive Phase 3 with a -3.6 MADRS delta (bar ~5) sold off 36-47%. Effect size, not p-value, sets HELP's reaction.
A clean psychedelic efficacy win produced ~+30% — the realistic first-day shape for HELP's Base.
Same molecule, earlier stage. Strong data was met with a muted +8%, a reminder that the psychedelic tape under-reacts to good news.

th.summary: REFRESH (รายงานก่อน 26 ต.ค. 2026): ผล topline Phase 3 APPROACH ของ HLP003 ใน MDD แบบเสริม (223 ราย รับครบ ก.ค. 2026) ยังคาดใน Q4 2026 ตามที่ยืนยันในงานนำเสนอนักลงทุน 21 ต.ค. แต่ยังไม่ระบุวัน หุ้นลง ~14% นับจาก 26 ต.ค. ส่วนใหญ่มาจากการร่วง ~18% ในวันเดียวเมื่อคู่แข่ง Usona ยื่นเอกสารกับ FDA ทำให้จุดเข้าถูกลง แต่ก็เตือนว่าการแข่งขันกลุ่ม psychedelic มีผู้เล่นมากกว่าหนึ่ง เป้า consensus $41.40 (11 นักวิเคราะห์) แต่กรณี Compass (ผ่าน Phase 3 แต่หุ้นร่วง 36-47% เพราะผลเล็ก) คือความเสี่ยงหลัก phase3_readout มี n=1 ใช้เป็นบริบทเท่านั้น Base +55% ($13.70 ใกล้จุดสูง ก.ย.) สมมติผลแยกจากยาหลอก ≥5 คะแนน MADRS ภายใน ~1-2 เดือนหลังผล สูงกว่า P75 30 วันจริง (+12.2%; bias +72.7pp) แนะนำ 2-3% ของ portfolio เท่านั้น — ถ้าผลอ่อน ลงได้ 40-60%

risks: เสี่ยง sell-the-news: Compass ผ่าน endpoint หลัก Phase 3 เมื่อ มิ.ย. 2025 แต่หุ้นร่วง 36-47% เพราะผลต่ำกว่าเกณฑ์ ~5 คะแนน MADRS HELP ต้องแยกจากยาหลอกชัด ไม่ใช่แค่มีนัยสำคัญทางสถิติ

การเดาได้ว่าได้ยาจริง (functional unblinding) และ expectancy effect เป็นข้อกังวลของ FDA ต่อการทดลอง psychedelic และ FDA เคยปฏิเสธ MDMA ของ Lykos (ส.ค. 2024)
